decisions.reason: As a 2019 launch shown on its own page, the lubrication system reflects visible investment and a public commitment in a core adjacent machinery niche, and with no clear evidence of failure management would likely justify continuation by pointing to long industrial sales cycles.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter appears to be part of the same committed 2019 product push, and under escalation-of-commitment logic the firm is more likely to persist unless there is unmistakable evidence of poor market acceptance, which the missing archived pages do not provide.

Because the gravity band coolant filter was also launched with its own page and fits the firm's established equipment offering, management would likely continue it for now, attributing any weak traction to temporary market conditions rather than reversing course quickly.
